articles.summary: CARLSBAD, Calif. , Jan. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Exagen Inc. (Nasdaq: XGN), a leading provider of autoimmune testing, today announced select preliminary unaudited financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025 , in line with prior financial guidance.
articles.title: Exagen Inc. Announces Select Preliminary 2025 Financial Results
